channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Thomas Robinson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Thomas Robinson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Thomas Robinson
item.description:
“They said it was a young one. I wasn’t here for it. But one tweet said Thomas (Robinson) jumped a few feet. It’s bizarre to have a venomous snake in your locker room. I don’t know if that’s happened before. That sounds like an ABA story.”

Terry Stotts on Thomas Robinson, May 8, 2014. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Thomas Robinson
item.description:
Jonathan Feigen:Blazers GM Neil Olshey on Thomas Robinson:

“He has the potential to be one of the best young power forwards in the league.”

Neil Olshey on Thomas Robinson, Jul 10, 2013. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Thomas Robinson
item.description:
If Robinson is slow to develop, you figure Morey will use him to turn 50 cents into a dollar once again.

“We tried to move up to get Thomas Robinson in the draft.”

Daryl Morey on Thomas Robinson, Feb 26, 2013. Source: SportsonEarth.

item.title: Patrick Patterson on Francisco Garcia, Thomas Robinson
item.description:
“They will add skill and depth along with the potential for a different look to our roster. We all want to thank Francisco, Thomas and Tyler for their efforts and contributions.”

Patrick Patterson on Francisco Garcia, Thomas Robinson, Feb 21, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Chris Webber on Thomas Robinson
item.description:
Webber raved about Kings rookie power forward Thomas Robinson, who was selected by Sacramento with the fifth overall pick, and how he would pair with budding star DeMarcus Cousins.

“I hear (Robinson) is undersized and stuff; my scouting report is - whoever is saying that, they're wrong, they don't know what the hell they're talking about,”

Chris Webber on Thomas Robinson, Jul 19, 2012. Source: news10.net.

item.title: Maurice Evans on Thomas Robinson
item.description:
Maurice Evans:

“As far as for number three, it would be a great pick if they picked Thomas Robinson,given that he’s from the area, he’s very mature for his age and it seems like he’s ready to contribute right away.”

Maurice Evans on Thomas Robinson, Jun 1, 2012. Source: Washington Post.
